claims.text: The declassification block printed on item 342UAP00005 reads 'Department of the Air Force / Air Force Declassification Office / Authority: FY24 NDAA, now codified at 44 U.S.C. 2107 / Date: 5/05/2025 / Declassified in Full: X / Case Number: 342UAP00005', showing that the Air Force ran the transfer as a declassification action under the UAP records statute and used the UAP Record Identifier as the declassification case number.

claims.nodeLabel: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection
claims.text: Item 342UAP00005, catalogued as 'Estimate of the Situation, September 8, 1948', is Headquarters Fifth Air Force, Office of the AC of S, A-2, APO 710, 'Estimate of the Situation' covering 7 August to 4 September 1948, 21 pages, published for Fifth Air Force Division and Wing-Base Commanders, with a table of contents covering Japan, Korea, China, the Philippines and Malaya. It is a periodic Far East theatre intelligence estimate and is not the Air Materiel Command estimate of 1948 that Ruppelt described.
